description: This PHP source file defines the AcmClient class in the Aws\Acm namespace, which provides methods to interact with AWS Certificate Manager service. It includes method signatures for various ACM operations such as managing certificates, tags, and configurations, with asynchronous variants.

classes.name: AcmClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Certificate Manager, extending AwsClient to include ACM-specific methods.

methods.name: addTagsToCertificate
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified certificate.

methods.name: describeCertificate
methods.description: Provides details about a specific certificate.

methods.name: getAccountConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the account configuration for ACM.

methods.name: listTagsForCertificate
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a certificate.

methods.name: putAccountConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the account configuration for ACM.

methods.name: resendValidationEmail
methods.description: Resends the validation email for a certificate.
